summary: The root of the host process: serves the page bundle and endpoints, and starts the library, settings, installation, preparation, export and install drivers per library.
creates: the configuration node from the environment (cache roots, budgets, idle source mode, overlays)
one child run of library and backups per library (real and verification)

faults.when: Another process holds the loopback port.

lifetime: The host process, from start to shutdown; aborting its token cancels every host run.

x-friction.gap: Two hand-made copies of every stateful host service serve the real and verification scopes.
x-friction.closes: Several graphs side by side, sharing drivers keyed by library.

x-friction.gap: A request's own abort isn't tied to the host work it starts.
x-friction.closes: Requests carrying their requester and lifetime into host work.
